items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Farrell. I remember watching him with Elvin there. That’s when I was young. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that was a tired place.

ctx.x: I remember Joe what’s-his-name, the saxophonist with Elvin. Was it? - who was it that played saxophone?
Joe Farrell. I remember watching him with Elvin there. That’s when I was young.
